```yaml
name: sccache warmup

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at midnight UTC daily
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  warmup:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Linux x86_64
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            build_type: debug
            features: "walrus-service/backup"
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            build_type: release
            features: ""
          # Linux ARM64
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            build_type: debug
            features: "walrus-service/backup"
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            build_type: release
            features: ""
          # Windows x86_64
          - os: windows-2022
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            build_type: debug
            features: "walrus-service/backup"
          - os: windows-2022
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            build_type: release
            features: ""
          # macOS x86_64
          - os: macos-13
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            build_type: debug
            features: "walrus-service/backup"
          - os: macos-13
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            build_type: release
            features: ""
          # macOS ARM64
          - os: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            build_type: debug
            features: "walrus-service/backup"
          - os: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            build_type: release
            features: ""

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Setup sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.9
        with:
          version: "v0.8.1"
        env:
          SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET: gs://walrus-sccache
          SCCACHE_GCS_RW_MODE: true
          SCCACHE_GCS_KEY_PREFIX: ${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ matrix.build_type }}
          # Use the service account credentials if available, otherwise rely on default auth
          # Note: In a real scenario, you might need to inject GCP credentials here if not using OIDC
          # For this example, we assume the runner has access or credentials are set via secrets/env
          GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS: ${{ secrets.GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Configure sccache environment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET=gs://walrus-sccache" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "SCCACHE_GCS_RW_MODE=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "SCCACHE_GCS_KEY_PREFIX=${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ matrix.build_type }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build workspace
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.build_type }}" == "release" ]; then
            cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --workspace
          else
            cargo build --target ${{ matrix.target }} --workspace --features "${{ matrix.features }}"
          fi

      - name: Post sccache stats
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          sccache --show-stats

  notify-failure:
    needs: warmup
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Dispatch failure event
        uses: peter-evans/repository-dispatch@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: MystenLabs/sui-operations
          event-type: sccache-warmup-failure
          client-payload: '{"ref": "${{ github.ref }}", "sha": "${{ github.sha }}", "run_id": "${{ github.run_id }}"}'
```
